verdict.rationale: NVIDIA Isaac is a robotics simulation and learning platform, and an agent-facing platform could plausibly offer credential scoping, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions API keys, tokens, scopes or least-privilege credentials, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The mentions of agent skills and automation pipelines are adjacent features and say nothing about issuing scoped credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
